item.title: Gaza Council of Peace: IDF withdrawal from Gaza only after complete disarmament of the Strip
item.description:
After the storm surrounding the "roadmap," the Gaza Council of Peace stated that Israel and the Council share the goal of complete disarmament in the Gaza Strip and a transition to civilian rule.
It was also emphasized that the IDF withdrawal beyond the Yellow Line will only take place after the dismantling of all weapons in the Strip, including light weapons, heavy weapons, and tunnels, has been completed.
